# 跳格子乘法探索台：a × b
a = 3   # 每次跳几格
b = 4   # 跳几次

hide()
col = 0
row = 0
i = 0
while i < a * b:
    x = -180 + (i - row * b) * 24
    y = 60 - row * 26
    pen_color("blue")
    pen_down()
    go_to(x, y)
    go_to(x + 20, y)
    go_to(x + 20, y - 20)
    go_to(x, y - 20)
    go_to(x, y)
    pen_up()

        row = row + 1
    i = i + 1

write("乘法就是数格子！", -190, 130, "blue", 12)

# 除法分组探索台
total = 12   # 总数量
each = 4     # 每组几个

hide()
groups = total / each
rem = total - groups * each
i = 0
while i < total:
    col = i - (i / each) * each
    row = i / each
    x = -180 + col * 26
    y = 70 - row * 30
    pen_color("blue")
    pen_down()
    go_to(x, y)
    go_to(x + 20, y)
    go_to(x + 20, y - 20)
    go_to(x, y - 20)
    go_to(x, y)
    pen_up()
    i = i + 1
write(total + " 个 ÷ 每组 " + each + " = " + groups + " 组", -190, 130, "red", 13)
if rem > 0:
    write("还剩 " + rem + " 个分不完整", -190, 105, "orange", 12)
if rem == 0:
    write("正好分完，没有余数！", -190, 105, "green", 12)

# 二次方程探索台：y = x² + bx + c（a=1）
b = -5   # 一次系数
c = 6    # 常数

hide()
a = 1
d = b * b - 4 * a * c
x1 = (0 - b + sqrt(d)) / (2 * a)
x2 = (0 - b - sqrt(d)) / (2 * a)
pen_color("blue")
pen_down()
x = -6
go_to(x * 22, (x * x + b * x + c) * 12)

    go_to(x * 22, (x * x + b * x + c) * 12)
    x = x + 0.25
pen_up()
pen_color("green")
pen_down()
go_to(-190, 0)
go_to(190, 0)
pen_up()
write("Δ = " + d, -180, 140, "orange", 13)
if d > 0:
    write("两个根 x₁=" + x1 + " x₂=" + x2, -180, 112, "red", 13)
    write("x=" + x1, x1 * 22 - 14, -22, "red", 11)
    write("x=" + x2, x2 * 22 - 14, -22, "red", 11)

# 三种增长大赛跑探索台
goal = 1000000   # 目标数

    p = p * 2
    steps = steps + 1
pen_color("red")

i = 0
v = 1

    v = v * 2
    xx = xx + 190 / steps

pen_down()
